<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's make a tower of books

Even if you learn a bunch, there's 
no way to use it in prison.

If there was a way to erase my past, 
I'd study it till my eyes were red...

Sure is. Way more dusty 
than in prison.

Surprising, isn't it? It was 
abnormally clean in the prison.

Mostly because of how strict 
the guards were...

Do you really think I'd want to 
do such a childish thing?

If so, then you clearly have no clue 
what kind of person I am.

If you're a detective, you need to 
learn to read people better.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Ryoma looks deep in thought...
